sources.title: CSCEC contractor reports May 3, 2025 groundbreaking of Longteng Liangshan AI Data Center Phase 1
facts: The contractor reports that Phase 1 broke ground on May 3.
Construction scope is one data center, one generator platform, one pump house, one gatehouse and external works; stated gross construction area is 30,800 square metres.
limitations: Location is only Liangshan prefecture; no parcel, street address, coordinates or named neighbouring feature.
The single embedded image is an architectural rendering, not an observed construction photograph.
No power, operation or full campus delivery inference.

sources.title: PowerChina project team reports February 8, 2026 structural topping of Liangshan AI data center substation switchgear building
facts: The 220 kV substation switchgear building structure was topped on February 8.
The report describes subsequent decoration and electrical equipment installation/commissioning as future stages.
limitations: The June 30, 2026 operation date is a future target in this February report, not achieved energization.
The substation work is a distinct supporting construction scope; transformer ratings are not data-center IT power.
No numeric location or georeferenceable plan is supplied.
